title: 第7章 各有麻烦第8章 虾道蟹道
lines: 第7章各有麻烦
“这话应该我问，”周凯笑起来，“我记得跟你说过一回，我算是在滨海长大的，你们怎么想起来到滨海定居？”
“我们祖籍就是滨海的，你这趟回来，长住还是住几天就走？”
“住一阵子再说吧。”周凯似是而非的答了句，“你给我留信息，是有事，还是就是告诉我一声你们在滨海？”
“当然是有事。”米丽不客气道：“没事留信息，那是没事找事。你要住一阵子，那最好，我记得你说过，那个叫邹玲的大律师，跟你关系不错？”
“有麻烦了？”周凯下意识的挺直了上身，声音里透着关切，“她收费高的离谱，不过，有事找到她，基本上都能解决。”
“麻烦是有，不过不是你想的那种麻烦。我们回来这一年多，光出不进，开了间旧货店，月月连房租钱都赚不够，幸好那店面是自己的，不然早关门了。
这样不行，坐吃山空，我和小夏商量着，想借着旁边街上宋家侦探社，接点案子做做，那位邹律师，能不能介绍点案子给我们做？”米丽直截了当。
周凯长长吐了口气，答应的十分干脆，“我问问她。你们？”周凯的手指划了半圈，点向盛夏。
“主要是小夏，我打杂。”米丽看了眼笑眯眯看着周凯的盛夏。
周凯呃了一声，侧头斜着盛夏，再看回米丽，再看看盛夏，突然一拍桌子，“对了，怎么没看到老常？”
“老常有点事儿，下个月就该回来了。”盛夏接话道。
周凯再次斜看向盛夏，迎着盛夏的目光，干笑了几声，双手撑在桌子上站起来，“手机号给我一个。”
米丽报了串号码。
周凯点头，“我先走了，买了手机就跟你联系，那家侦探社地址电话，回头你发我手机上。”
米丽应了，站起来送周凯出去，盛夏坐在桌边，抿着茶看着两人出去。
环贸大厦后面那部专用电梯门口，黄云生堆着一脸恭敬到不能再恭敬的笑，侧着身子，走一步至少哈两回腰，让着位西装笔挺的中年人进了电梯，自己哈着腰一个旋身进去，屁股差点撞到中年人。
黄云生按了楼层，冲中年人一连几个哈腰之后，摸出手机，按通了，一只手捂着嘴，又是激动又是兴奋的低低道：“赶紧告诉老大，进电梯了。”
站在电梯中间的中年人，眼角往下斜着黄云生，嘴角往下扯了扯。
这样的手下，主人可想而知，他之前过于谨慎了。
电梯门开，黄云生伸手拦在电梯门上，再次连连哈腰，紧跟在中年人身后出来，一眼没看到他们老大，瞪着笔直站在卫桓办公室门口，眼珠都不敢多转一下的马国伟，急的乱挥手，“老大呢？我不是给你打电话了？”
一句话说完，赶紧点头哈腰堆着一脸笑和中年人解释，“那个，我们老板的办公室有点儿大，得走一会儿……”
“让他进来。”屋里一声冷淡中透着丝丝不悦的声音，打断了黄云生的瞎解释。
中年人眉头微皱，片刻舒开，抬脚进了屋。
content_en:
Chapter 7 Everyone has trouble
"I should ask this," Zhou Kai laughed, "I remember telling you once that I grew up in Binhai. Why do you think of settling in Binhai?"
"Our ancestral home is Binhai. When you come back this time, will you stay for a long time or will you stay for a few days and then leave?"
"We'll talk after we stay for a while." Zhou Kai replied speciously, "Did you leave me a message because you had something to do, or did you just tell me that you were in Binhai?"
"Of course there is something going on." Mi Li said bluntly: "If you leave a message if you have nothing to do, you are looking for trouble. If you want to stay for a while, that would be best. I remember you said that the lawyer named Zou Ling has a good relationship with you?"
"Are you in trouble?" Zhou Kai straightened his upper body subconsciously, with concern in his voice, "Her charges are ridiculously high, but if you find her, you can basically solve the problem."
"There is trouble, but it's not the kind of trouble you think. We've been back for more than a year, we can't go out, we've opened a thrift store, and we can't even make enough rent every month. Fortunately, we own the store, otherwise it would have closed long ago.
This doesn't work, we're sitting on nothing, so Xiaoxia and I discussed using the Song's Detective Agency on the street next door to take on some cases. Can Lawyer Zou introduce some cases to us? Millie said bluntly.
Zhou Kai took a long breath and agreed very simply, "I'll ask her. You?" Zhou Kai made a half circle with his finger and pointed at Sheng Xia.
"Mainly Xiaoxia, I do odd jobs." Mi Li glanced at Shengxia who looked at Zhou Kai with a smile.
Zhou Kai made a sound, tilted his head towards Sheng Xia, then looked back at Mili, then at Sheng Xia, and suddenly slapped the table, "By the way, why didn't you see Lao Chang?"
"Lao Chang has something to do. He should be back next month." Shengxia answered.
Zhou Kai looked sideways at Sheng Xia again, met Sheng Xia's gaze, laughed a few times, stood up with his hands on the table, "Give me a mobile phone number."
Millie reported the serial number.
Zhou Kai nodded, "I'm leaving first. I'll contact you after I buy a mobile phone. You can send the address and phone number of the detective agency to my mobile phone later."
Mi Li agreed and stood up to see Zhou Kai out. Shengxia sat at the table, sipping tea and watching the two go out.
……………………
At the door of the special elevator behind the International Trade Building, Huang Yunsheng put on a smile that could not be more respectful. He leaned sideways and bent his waist at least twice with each step, allowing a middle-aged man in a straight suit to enter the elevator. He bent around and walked in, almost bumping into the middle-aged man with his butt.
Huang Yunsheng pressed the floor button, and after bowing to the middle-aged man several times, he took out his mobile phone and pressed the call. He covered his mouth with one hand and whispered excitedly: "Hurry up and tell the boss that you have entered the elevator."
The middle-aged man standing in the middle of the elevator looked at Huang Yunsheng from the corner of his eyes and pulled down the corners of his mouth.
With such a subordinate, the master can imagine that he was too cautious before.
When the elevator door opened, Huang Yunsheng stretched out his hand to block the elevator door. He bowed again and followed the middle-aged man out. Without seeing their boss, he stared at Ma Guowei, who was standing straight at the door of Wei Huan's office, not daring to turn his eyes. He waved anxiously, "Where's the boss? Didn't I call you?"
After finishing the sentence, he quickly nodded and bowed and explained to the middle-aged man with a smile on his face, "Well, our boss's office is a bit big, so we have to walk for a while..."
"Let him in." A cold voice with a hint of displeasure in the room interrupted Huang Yunsheng's blind explanation.
The middle-aged man frowned slightly, relaxed for a moment, and walked into the house.
